answer: A hostile operator running 31 aliases as a result needs 199 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in shale, expire in cipher, and sparrow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 35 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
